quests.title: The Lost Child's Tale

dialogue.t: I can't find... *sobs* I can't find...
Daddy! Mommy! They're waiting for me at home. I've gotta get back there!
It's home! I've found the way back!
The lights are still on, and Mom's made piping-hot pie... Oh, it's wonderful!
Daddy's waiting for me too... Daddy, Mommy, I'm home!

quests.description: Listen to the ghosts’ whispers and retrieve their names.
